A [[human]] '''old man''' lived in a [[Unidentified farm village|farm village]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. [[Gender|He]] held a supervisory role for the [[farmer]]s there, doling out [[water]] for anyone who needed it and announcing when breaks and mealtimes occurred. Unlike [[Unidentified village brother|one]] of his workers, he was critical of the [[Galactic Empire]], believing it to be built on tyranny and oppression. The old man was one of four survivors of the village after it was [[Attack on a farm village|attacked]] by the [[Eleventh Brother]] in search of [[Great Jedi Purge]] survivor [[Ahsoka Tano]], who had been working in the village under the alias "Ashla". Tano defeated the [[Inquisitor]], and the old man and the two other survivors, a brother and [[Unidentified village sister|sister]], were taken to safety by [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]].<ref name="Resolve" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
The Old Man is nice and will give his workers what they need while working. He is even against the Empire because they were built on tyranny and oppression. When the Eleventh Brother arrived because one of the farmers discover that Ashla was a Jedi, he was sadden to see his home destroy and fellow farmers killed.<ref name="Resolve" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Old Man was voiced by [[David Shaughnessy]]<ref name="Resolve" /> who also voiced both [[Myles Grint]] and [[Cumberlayne Aresko]] from ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''.<ref name="spark">''[[Star Wars Rebels: Spark of Rebellion]]''</ref>
